errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите, представени като стълбове
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart where the categories are on the vertical axis and the numerical values are on the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly swaps the axes' roles.
The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the bars have length, not height. This phrasing incorrectly implies a vertical bar chart.
There is no bar with a value of 0. The bars with the lowest value in the chart have a value of 3.

This category does not exist in the chart. The chart has two similar but distinct categories: 'друга информация' (other information) and 'друго (посочете какво)' (other (specify what)). The description provides a garbled and incorrect version.
The category 'загуба' (loss) is not present in the chart.

The list of categories is incomplete. It omits several categories shown in the chart, including 'годишнина', 'брой', 'DOI', 'url', 'друго (посочете какво)', 'друга информация', and 'Транслитерация на цитираната литература'.

The chart's title is 'Bibliographic data for cited literature' and the numerical axis has no label. Stating that the values represent the 'number of cited publications' is an interpretation, not a direct description of what is shown.

The transcription of the category label is inaccurate. The chart shows 'автор/и ( напр. само 1-ия; всички или определен..)', and the description misses several characters ( 'и', '(', '..' ) and alters others.
The category label is 'страници' (plural for pages), not 'страница' (singular for page).
